name: news
title: News
summary: The news on the topics you follow, from a mix of English and French outlets you can see, grouped into stories on your own machine and told once. No model, no account, no service in between.

manifest.name: news

tools.name: news.topics
tools.description: The news topics the owner follows: each one's id, name, keywords, how many sources feed it and which are failing, whether the owner muted it, and how many stories it had in the last 24 hours.

tools.name: news.headlines
tools.description: The top news stories for a topic (or every topic) in rank order, each grouped from several outlets: title, lead, link, outlets, languages, times, and whether it was told already (new, update, told). Use it for "what's the news", a brief, or before telling the owner about a topic; untold: true for what has not been told.

tools.name: news.story
tools.description: One news story in full: every article on it with its outlet, language, title, lead, link and time (the timeline), which are opinion or paywalled, and when it was told. Use it before saying more about a story than its title.

tools.name: news.search
tools.description: Search the articles kept on this machine from the owner's sources for every word of the query, newest first, each with its story id, outlet, link, language and available cached image. Once a result matches the story requested, call news.story with its storyId before explaining it, to retrieve all sources and its illustration. Never answer from memory.

tools.name: news.mark_told
tools.description: Record that these stories were told to the owner (by Anchor, in a brief), so news.headlines with untold: true leaves them out until there is a material update. Call it once the stories have actually been told.

tools.name: news.feedback
tools.description: The owner's word on the news: not interested in a story, mute an outlet or a topic, snooze a story or a topic, or clear one of these. Use it when the owner says so ("stop showing me this", "not today"), never on your own. Name exactly one of storyId, outlet or topic.

tools.name: news.editions
tools.description: Retrieve saved editions, newest first, with their exact text and links. With no arguments returns the latest saved edition and total saved count. Filter by kind for the latest morning, midday or evening edition, or id for a specific edition. Increase limit to list recent editions. Use this when asked to show the last edition or how many editions are saved; never reconstruct one from headlines or edition material.

tools.name: news.edition_material
tools.description: The material for a news edition: untold stories first (new, or told with an update since), grouped by topic in the owner's order, each with its outlets (language, kind, and lean where known), 2 to 4 articles with links, whether it is opinion; the stories already told, the owner's language, whether to read it aloud, and whether the owner asked for quiet news today. Call it first when writing an edition (a mission may already have handed it to you).

tools.name: news.edition_save
tools.description: Record a news edition once it is written: its text and the stories it told, so the next edition skips them unless they have a material update. The one write an edition makes; call it in the same turn as the report.

tools.name: news.quiet_today
tools.description: The owner's "Quiet news today": the editions left today are skipped (their material says so) until midnight, then they resume by themselves. Call it when the owner taps Quiet news today or says so; undo: true takes it back.

tools.name: news.read
tools.description: The text of a news article, fetched once from the outlet when the summary is not enough to answer, and kept a week: a story's best article, or one article. Refused for a paywalled outlet, a page its robots.txt closes, and past 20 reads a day; then answer from the headline and summary and say so.

tools.name: news.mute_outlet
tools.description: Mute a news outlet everywhere — its articles leave every story, the page and the editions — or turn it back on. Only when the owner asks ("stop showing me Fox News"); the owner approves it first.

tools.name: news.enable_starter
tools.description: Turn on the starter topics (all, or those named) with their checked English and French sources.

tools.name: news.add_source
tools.description: Add a feed to topics: the address is checked to answer a feed (or a page naming one), its outlet made and its logo fetched once.

tools.name: news.set_source
tools.description: Change a source: mute it or turn it back on, rename it, or set the topics it feeds (with a keywords filter).

tools.name: news.remove_source
tools.description: Remove a source (from one topic, or altogether) and the articles only it brought.

tools.name: news.retry_source
tools.description: Try a failing or paused source again now.

tools.name: news.add_topic
tools.description: Add a topic of the owner's own: a name, keywords, and feeds; with no feed, a Google News search in each language.

tools.name: news.set_topic
tools.description: Change a topic: its name, its keywords, or mute it for some hours.

tools.name: news.remove_topic
tools.description: Remove a topic with its stories; sources that fed only it go too.

tools.name: news.hide_story
tools.description: Not interested in a story, snooze it until tomorrow (back sooner if it has news), or Undo.

tools.name: news.set_settings
tools.description: How long news is kept, which editions are read aloud, and Forget what was told.

tools.name: news.refresh
tools.description: Fetch now: every source of a topic, or whatever is due.

tools.name: news.add_feed
tools.description: Add a source to a topic from what the owner typed: a feed, a site that names one, or words for a Google News search; checked before it is saved.

tools.name: news.download_meaning
tools.description: Ask buddi to download the meaning model that groups stories by what they say, and the engine it runs on, to this computer. The owner approves one card first. The owner's own.

tools.name: news.finish_meaning_setup
tools.description: Finish the first News setup step after the model is ready, or explicitly choose word matching for now.

tools.name: news.choose_custom_sources
tools.description: Choose to add your own first topic and sources during News setup.
